_note: v6 cut list (35-45 s). One problem line, one real run, one honest miss, end card. No human figures anywhere. Fictional shop = small online gift shop; demo data = public UK gift-shop export (UCI Online Retail II), replayed. Every number comes from the recorded run (runs/20261017-002725-602783, demo/raw-v4e) and eval files.

scenes.text: A small online gift shop guesses by eye what to order for next week. The fast seller runs out. The slow one piles up.

scenes.caption: Real app, real run. Demo file: public UK gift-shop export, headers renamed to test odd names
scenes.text: So the owner drops her order export into Tidy Predict.

scenes.caption: Headers the rules cannot place go to Gemma, running on this laptop
scenes.text: Gemma, running on the laptop, reads the odd headers.

scenes.caption: Real run: 139 s on a laptop CPU, log sped up. TabPFN-2 forecasts, Gemma writes
scenes.text: Code cleans a million rows. Tab, P, F, N, two forecasts twenty regular sellers. Gemma writes the note.

scenes.caption: The restock note. Code checks every number in it
scenes.text: Out comes a restock note. Code checks every number in it.

scenes.caption: 17 of 20 inside their range. Rabbit night light: expected 1,249, really sold 4,452
scenes.text: Now. The honest miss. Rabbit night lights: expected about twelve hundred. Sold about forty-four hundred.
